people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jerusalem

translations.web: David took more wives at Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
